description: Bump Bar Chart is a custom Power BI visual built to show how categories move up or down across time periods, scenarios, or comparison groups. It combines rank movement with actual values so report consumers can see not only who changed position, but also by how much. The visual supports both bar and bubble layouts, connected lines between periods, optional trend columns, configurable data labels, rank numbers, and category images. It is designed for reports where movement, comparison, and magnitude all matter in the same view. Use Bump Bar Chart to analyze sales rankings, market-share shifts, campaign performance, product performance, leaderboards, and other business scenarios where category position changes over time. Key capabilities: - Switch between bar and bubble chart layouts - Show connected lines to track category movement across columns - Emphasize top categories and highlight important connectors - Add optional trend columns for quick per-category context - Format labels, fonts, colors, spacing, and zero-axis display - Show category labels, category images, or both - Support positive and negative values in the same visual All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark. To use the visual without watermark in Power BI Online, please purchase license subscription For more…
